parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description: The name of the dataset. For more information, see [Create a dataset](~~478160~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the project. For more information, see [CreateProject](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: URI
parameters.description:
The URI of the OSS bucket to which the dataset is bound.

Specify the value in the oss://${Bucket} format. `${Bucket}` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm delete-binding --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --uri oss://test-bucket --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
